invariants.rationale: Method always returns a BulkInsertPartitioner instance, never null, in both branches.
Method always dereferences strategyParams, so it must not be null.
Method always dereferences schema (for addMetadataFields), so it must not be null.
If the parameters contain the sort columns key, JavaCustomColumnsSortPartitioner is returned; otherwise not.
If the key is not present, a fallback BulkInsertPartitioner implementation is returned.
